vibe_rationale: Highly regarded electronic camping festival with a serious underground lineup, though promoter-run and a little more commercial.
fit_notes: Adult electronic camping crowd across five days in the Grampians, with room for recovery, hydration or wellness amenities. Partners so far are a media brand, a bag brand and camping suppliers, with no health precedent, and only a general email is published. Untitled Group runs several festivals, so a deal could extend across its portfolio.
